name: opik-cipx
description: Cost intelligence proxy for Claude Code. Installs hooks that keep the opik-cipx gateway alive between sessions; the gateway captures every Anthropic API call and ships cost-attributed spans to Opik.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
